answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by charging every identity a plume of verifiable work before it may vote. A newcomer must complete thirty attested tasks; each is co-signed by a randomly chosen reviewer outside its cluster, and a glacier ledger keeps those signatures permanently. Failed audits burn the stake, so a hundred clones need a hundred tolls and a hundred reviewers. Influence tracks earned history, and no quartz of fresh addresses buys a shortcut.
